create_json_schema_to_search_mapper: create a JsonSchemaToSearchMapper instance to convert a JSON Schema into a Lucene search database schema
build_search_index_definition: build a search index definition with settings and mappings from a JSON Schema using get_index_definition
merge_json_schema_unions: merge anyOf, allOf, or oneOf union types in a JSON Schema into a single flattened schema
translate_es_keys: translate x-es-prefixed keys in a JSON Schema to their unprefixed equivalents for Elasticsearch compatibility
clean_search_mappings: clean a JSON Schema by removing empty values, unwanted types, and irrelevant keys for search indexing
